simple.meaning: פָּנִין (pânîyn) is a Hebrew word meaning “probably a pearl (as round).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פָּנִין (H6443) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 28:18, with occurrences in Job, Proverbs, Lamentations.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּנִין (H6443) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פָּנִין (H6443) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פָּנִין (pânîyn) / H6443 is traced through Job 28:18, Proverbs 3:15, Proverbs 8:11, Proverbs 20:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6443. peninim מְּנִינִים noun [feminine] plural corals (? as branching compare Arabic branch of tree; so Mich Thes and others; > pearls Bo Hieroz. 601 Di Jb after Ra and others); — ׳פ figurative of value Prov 20:15 ; usually ׳מִמּ , camp. Job 28:18 ; Prov 3:15 (Kt מפניים ), 8:11 ; 31:10 (all of value), Lam 4:7 (of red colour); + Psa 45:14 (perhaps; for מְּנִימָה , q. v. ).
definitions.rootNote: or פָּנִי ; from the same as 6434 ;
